notes.title: FIRST CONTACT
notes.notes:
Hello! 

My name is Julien, [b]creator of the game UNDER DEATH[/b]. I recently left an international media company to fulfill my dream: to create my own game with no experience in this industry. An intimidating yet exciting experience. Thanks to the incredibly welcoming and helpful indie developer community, I can now present UNDER DEATH to you. 

Inspired by creators like Maddy Thorson (Celeste), Edmund McMillen (The Binding of Isaac), and Sébastien Bénard (Dead Cells), my game Under Death is designed to allow each player to create their own way of playing with a fluid and instinctive game feel. Accessible yet deep in its possibilities, it allows players to find their own way to win. 

I will keep you updated on the development progress. The graphics will be improved very soon (while staying in pixel art, I love it). [b]A demo will be available in the first quarter of 2025[/b]. 

Your support is invaluable, and I can't wait to share this exciting adventure with you. 
[b]Thank you for accompanying me on this journey![/b]
